heading: Projects
intro: Substantial technical work, from LLM routing infrastructure to a pipelined processor. Source is linked for each.

items.title: Adaptive Semantic Pipeline for LLM Routing
items.subtitle: ASP
items.description: An eight-stage routing pipeline that decomposes prompts into a semantic DAG and dispatches sub-tasks to strong or weak models, cutting inference cost by roughly half without losing accuracy.
details: Architected an 8-stage LLM routing pipeline decomposing prompts into a semantic DAG (spaCy, SentenceTransformer, constituency parsing) and routing sub-tasks to strong/weak models via a 27-feature LightGBM router with BFS strong-inheritance — 85.66% accuracy, 88.04% F1 — cutting inference cost ~49% at 131 ms mean latency.

Fine-tuned a dual-head DistilBERT (11-class intent plus complexity regression; 83.32% accuracy, 85.32% F1) and built an async DAG execution engine with speculative execution, semantic caching, and a context blackboard, saving 60–80% of tokens.
Layered a 3-stage safety, NLI-verification, and LLM-as-a-Judge stack on top of the routing and aggregation pipeline.

items.title: CanvasMind
items.subtitle: Multi-Agent Inference-Time RL for Creative AI
items.description: Generative agents co-paint a shared canvas under an inference-time RL layer, with reward misalignment treated as the object of study rather than a bug to paper over.
details: Built a multi-agent creative-AI system in which generative agents co-paint a shared canvas under an inference-time RL layer using best-of-N search, a batched reward model, a persistent UCB1 bandit, and reward-triggered Reflexion self-correction.

Modelled agent interactions with misaligned per-agent rewards as a general-sum game; applied Shapley-value, empowerment, and Goodhart diagnostics to identify and correct 4 RL defects, lifting composite quality from -0.05 to +1.66 at equal compute across a 4,000-session ablation.

items.title: PolyQuery
items.subtitle: Multi-Model Relational Algebra Engine
items.description: A disk-backed C++17 database engine unifying relational algebra, graph traversal, and vector search under a fixed ten-page memory ceiling.
details: Engineered a high-performance, integer-optimised C++17 RDBMS unifying relational algebra, graph processing, and high-dimensional vector search over a custom block-based buffer manager with external-memory algorithms (external merge sort, hashing, B-Tree).

Implemented multi-threaded transactions with Wait-Die concurrency control and page-granular shared/exclusive locking (deadlock-free), disk-backed BFS path queries, and KNN search (Euclidean/Cosine) via a bounded min-heap under a fixed 10-page memory ceiling.

items.title: 32-bit RISC-V Processor
items.subtitle: Sequential to 5-stage pipeline
items.description: A 32-bit RISC-V core in Verilog, scaled from a single-cycle datapath to a five-stage pipeline with full hazard resolution and a Python assembler.
details: Designed a 32-bit RISC-V processor in Verilog, scaling from a single-cycle sequential datapath to a 5-stage IF/ID/EX/MEM/WB pipeline, including PC, register file, instruction/data memories, ALU/control, and immediate-generation units for R-, I-, S-, and B-type instructions.

Engineered forwarding and hazard-detection units for data, double-data, load-store, control, and load-use hazards using forwarding, stalls, and branch flushes; built a Python assembler and iVerilog testbenches validating Fibonacci, linear search, vector addition, and summation programs.

items.title: POSIX-Core C Shell
items.subtitle: Systems programming suite
items.description: A modular Unix shell in C with unlimited pipelines, full redirection, twelve-plus built-ins, and verified leak-free execution.
details: Developed a modular execvp-based Unix shell with foreground/background execution, unlimited pipelines, full I/O redirection, and .myshrc alias resolution; verified leak-free execution with Valgrind.
Implemented 12+ built-ins (hop, reveal, seek, log, proclore, activities, fg/bg, neonate, and an iMan TCP man-page fetcher) with robust SIGINT/SIGTSTP/SIGCHLD handling and asynchronous child reaping.
